title: Piasecki Steel
desc: Engineering Shop Intern at Piasecki Steel in 2024, developing machining templates and helping fabricate safety equipment for bridge-repair work.
body1: As an Engineering Shop Intern in Castleton, NY (June–August 2024), I developed templates from engineering drawings to improve machining accuracy on steel components, and helped fabricate a ladder and ladder cage used to improve worker safety during bridge repairs across New York and the surrounding area.

title: Student Living & Learning
desc: Supporting RPI's Assistant Deans with day-to-day operations and fielding parent questions about students' time on campus.
body1: Since September 2024, I've worked as a Work Study student with RPI's Office of Student Living and Learning in Troy, NY, aiding the Assistant Deans with day-to-day tasks that keep the office running and help ensure student success.
body2: A large part of the role is direct communication, answering questions from parents about their students' time on campus, and making sure issues get routed to the right person quickly.

title: Best Buy
desc: Sales Advisor at Best Buy store #531 in 2023, matching customers to the right product and walking them through protection plans and payment options.
body1: As a Sales Advisor at store #531 in Portland, ME (summer to fall 2023), I helped customers find the product that actually fit what they were trying to do, then explained the protection plans and payment methods that applied to the purchase.

title: The Forge
desc: Room Manager at RPI's student makerspace since 2022, helping students through rapid prototyping and DFM, and keeping the machines running.
body1: Since the fall of 2022 I have worked as a Room Manager at The Forge, RPI's student makerspace in Troy, NY. Half the job is consulting: a student arrives with a project and no idea where to start, and I help them work out what to make it from and which process will actually get them there.
body2: The other half is upkeep. I repair and maintain the equipment the room runs on, the 3D printers, the laser cutter, and the vinyl printer, so the machines are there when somebody needs them.
body3: I also organized and created the Room Manager Union at The Forge.

body1: As a Kumon instructor in Cape Elizabeth, ME (fall 2021 to summer 2022), I created study plans and curriculums for up to fifteen students at a time, built to get the most out of the hours they spent at the learning center. That covered tests, homework, and one on one sessions.

title: Waynflete Stage Crew
desc: Stage Manager for Waynflete's productions, running the schedule and production plan for casts and crews of up to sixty people.

body2: Casts ran up to sixty people, which made the work far more about coordination than about any single task on the list.
